query.text: 请帮我留意行李转盘，看到第一个带白色行李牌的黑色行李箱时告诉我。
query.text_en: Please watch the baggage carousel and notify me when you see the first black suitcase with a white baggage tag.

annotation.text_zh: 第一个能明确看到白色行李牌的黑色行李箱来了。
annotation.text_en: The first clearly identifiable black suitcase with a white baggage tag is coming around.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
